result.question: What does Yahweh's word say to the man?

readings.answer: That his body shall never reach the tomb of his fathers.
readings.support: your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers.

readings.answer: That he went back and ate and drank where he was told not to.
readings.support: but you went back and ate bread and drank water in the place where He told you not to do so,

assessments.reason: The statement “your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers” directly corresponds to the key’s idea that he will not be buried (with his fathers).

“This is what the LORD says … you went back and ate bread and drank water in the place where He told you not to do so” is also part of what Yahweh’s word says to the man, even though the key focuses on the burial consequence.

result.reason: The LORD’s speech includes both the rebuke about eating and drinking where forbidden and the penalty about not reaching his fathers’ tomb, so more than one materially different answer fits the question.
